Welcome to Beginner's SampaLuck 2024! This competition features the events **3x3, 2x2, 4x4, 3x3 One-Handed, and Pyraminx**, with **3x3 Cube** as the main event.

We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.

This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.

items.name: Stockholmsligan 388: Piratens Hämnd - 2024
items.information:
Varmt välkomna till den femte deltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien).

Mer information om Stockholmligans upplägg finns under fliken med samma namn. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information.

--

A warm welcome to the fifth competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). 

More information about the league's structure can be found under the tab with the same name. Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.
